#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Ephemeral, network-isolated, resource-capped container runner via Podman/Docker."""

import argparse
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


def _runtime() -> str:
    if shutil.which("podman"):
        return "podman"
    if shutil.which("docker"):
        return "docker"
    raise RuntimeError("Neither podman nor docker is available on PATH")


def sandbox_run(
    command: str,
    workspace: str | None = None,
    image: str = "debian:stable-slim",
    timeout: int = 60,
    network: str = "none",
    memory: str = "2g",
    pids: int = 512,
    cpus: float = 2.0,
) -> str:
    runtime = _runtime()

    argv = [
        runtime, "run", "--rm", "--pull=missing",
        f"--network={network}",
        f"--memory={memory}",
        f"--pids-limit={pids}",
        f"--cpus={cpus}",
        "--cap-drop=ALL",
        "--security-opt=no-new-privileges",
    ]

    if workspace is not None:
        argv.extend(["-v", f"{workspace}:/workspace:rw", "-w", "/workspace"])

    argv.extend([image, "sh", "-c", command])

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return "exit=124\n--- stdout ---\n--- stderr ---\n"

    stdout = result.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    stderr = result.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    combined = f"exit={result.returncode}\n--- stdout ---\n{stdout}--- stderr ---\n{stderr}"

    if len(combined.encode("utf-8")) > 50000:
        truncated = combined.encode("utf-8")[:50000].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        marker = "... [truncated]"
        sep_idx = truncated.rfind("--- stderr ---")
        if sep_idx != -1:
            combined = truncated[:sep_idx] + marker + "\n--- stderr ---\n" + truncated[sep_idx + len("--- stderr ---"):].rsplit("\n", 1)[0] + "\n" + marker + "\n"
        else:
            combined = truncated + "\n" + marker + "\n"

    return combined


def _build_arg_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="sandbox.py",
        description="Run a command in an ephemeral, network-isolated, resource-capped container.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--image", default="debian:stable-slim")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--network", default="none")
    parser.add_argument("--memory", default="2g")
    parser.add_argument("--pids", type=int, default=512)
    parser.add_argument("--cpus", type=float, default=2.0)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", default=os.getcwd())
    return parser


def main() -> int:
    parser = _build_arg_parser()

    if "--" not in sys.argv:
        parser.error("A `--` separator is required before the command.")

    dash_idx = sys.argv.index("--")
    known_args = parser.parse_args(sys.argv[1:dash_idx])
    cmd_args = sys.argv[dash_idx + 1:]

    if not cmd_args:
        parser.error("A command is required after the `--` separator.")

    command = " ".join(cmd_args)

    output = sandbox_run(
        command=command,
        workspace=known_args.workspace,
        image=known_args.image,
        timeout=known_args.timeout,
        network=known_args.network,
        memory=known_args.memory,
        pids=known_args.pids,
        cpus=known_args.cpus,
    )

    print(output, end="")

    exit_match = output.split("\n", 1)[0]
    if exit_match.startswith("exit="):
        try:
            exit_code = int(exit_match[5:])
        except ValueError:
            exit_code = 1
    else:
        exit_code = 1

    sys.exit(exit_code)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
